description: Updates exercise metadata (name, description, muscle groups, categories, equipment, skill level, tags, side, coach). Use when the user wants to fix or improve exercise tagging. Only team-owned exercises can be updated; stock exercises are read-only. Provide at least one field to update besides exercise_id.

categories.description: Up to 3 exercise categories, e.g. ["strength", "mobility"]. Replaces the current ones.

category_ids.description: Up to 3 exercise categories, e.g. ["strength", "mobility"]. Older name for categories; used only when categories is not set.

coach.description: The coach in the video: "male" or "female".

description.description: Short movement description, up to 2000 characters.

equipment_ids.description: Replaces the equipment. IDs from list_equipment.

exercise_id.description: Team-owned exercise ID from list_team_exercises (availability "team"). Stock exercises can't be edited.

muscle_group_ids.description: Replaces the muscle groups. IDs from list_muscle_groups.

tags.description: Up to 5 free-text tags, e.g. ["core", "no equipment"]. Replaces the current tags.

team_id.description: Not used: this tool works on the signed-in team. Leave it out.

name: update_exercise_metadata
title: Update exercise metadata
